subject: Mechanical Engineering
title: Toggle Mechanisms: Maximum Force at Dead Center
description: A short lesson to help you apply Toggle Mechanisms: Maximum Force at Dead Center.

hook.text: Push two links nearly straight and the output force shoots to infinity.

buildup.text: At toggle position, the links align and the mechanical advantage soars.

discovery.text: A small input force creates a huge clamping or crushing force at toggle.

twist.text: Past toggle, the force reverses. The mechanism must be stopped at the right instant.

climax.text: Stone crushers, clamping jaws, and toggle presses all exploit this effect.

punchline.text: Align the links and a finger press becomes a crushing blow.

quiz.question: Why does a toggle mechanism produce such high force?
options: The motor speeds up at the toggle point
When links align, mechanical advantage approaches infinity at dead center
The links store elastic energy and release it suddenly
